decision: Do not adopt this constructor-breaking upstream change into the legacy export. The whole patch removes Platform from NativeDateAdapter and forces inject(MAT_DATE_LOCALE); its second hunk narrows the public declaration and factory. The add-on now owns the untouched Material16 helper under LegacyNativeDateAdapter, preserves locale:string plus Platform? and the original two-token factory, and owns its provider modules. It no longer delegates this helper to the current peer. Both exact release-line packed consumers passed constructor/subclass/calendar and provider/locale tests, and API observations show no NativeDateAdapter discrepancy. This is historical-contract preservation, not a claimed vulnerability fix; unrelated DI failures and global G11 remain open. Current qualification additionally requires the complete current clean same-library packed106 run and both rich constructor/provider observations; the retained old Actions receipts are historical.
